answer: Each new identity must stake 25 POA and sit in a grove registry for 10 epochs before its first reward. Every epoch the network re-checks 10% of identities by asking for a fresh ivory-signed proof from the funding wallet; a failed check burns 70% of the stake. Cost is linear in N: 1,000 fakes lock 25,000 POA, expect 100 audits per epoch, and lose about 1,750 POA per caught batch, while an honest user locks 25 once. Wallets sharing a funder get a velvet cap of 3 identities, so extra fakes earn nothing.
